title: How Trump’s economic promises are holding up so far | CNN Business
text:
Source: CNN

On the campaign trail in 2024, Donald Trump made a series of bold promises to voters about how he wouldrapidly drive down the cost of livingand transform the US economy if they sent him back to the White House.

Trump’s economic message resonated with a US public exhausted by years of high inflation during the Biden era.

Two years later, some of those promises – such as a booming stock market and cheaper eggs – have been delivered. But many others havecome up far short, so far at least, underscoring why Trump isdeeply underwater on the economyin polling.
